verdict: Inference completed correctly; custom-engine performance value was not demonstrated.

code_findings.finding: Unsupported/no-scratch prefill returns false before central dispatch and logging. Scratch only reserved when some CUTLASS candidate beats reference.
choose returns reference for missing baseline, absent/incorrect candidate, or candidate not strictly faster.
Calibration measures and numerically checks candidates. Normal inference does not rerun numeric comparisons; missing profile may silently yield all reference apart from initial profile status log.
Acceptance verifies retrieval/stream completion, model/binding/context and idleness, but does not require custom-kernel execution or performance improvement.

limitations: Sampled host dispatch log is not a complete GPU execution trace.
changes: No source changes. No rollback decision taken. Stock runtime is temporarily selected only for user-requested baselines.
